summary: All TDD anchors covered at the right pyramid layer. The dispatch side effect is asserted via verify() on the FunnelEventService boundary — appropriate because the unit-of-dispatch (trigger type, matchKey, originDepth) is exactly Task 5's responsibility; the real fan-out is covered separately by the engine. ITs add real-DB behavioral assertions (audit written / not written) alongside the dispatch verify and prove the wired bean (full-context boot = no BeanCurrentlyInCreationException). No redundant tests; each new test pins a distinct contract point.

coverage.context_starts_after_wiring: satisfied by SubscriberServiceImplIT / SubscriberTagAssignmentIT booting the full graph with FunnelEventService injected into both StepExecutor and SubscriberServiceImpl (task allows reusing an existing full-context boot rather than duplicating)
